semantics: For each instance feed the telemetry samples to StateAwareController(config).observe in order, then call decide(state, candidates, epoch). Qhat(p) = c_install (unless ignore_install) + sum_j s_j exec_j + c_wait_s over H = remaining_epochs with the survival vector given (s_j = (1 - 1/D)^j, D = (dwell_prior + sum completed dwells + current age) / (1 + completed), or all ones when stationary_survival); exec_j = exec_s_by_epoch[min(j, n - 1)] when the candidate carries that list (n its length), else exec_s_per_epoch. U_diff = sqrt(var_keep + var_p); with a_j = s_j sigma_j (sigma_j = exec_sigma_by_epoch[min(j, n - 1)], else exec_sigma) var = sum a_j^2 + epoch_corr ((sum a_j)^2 - sum a_j^2) + c_install_sigma^2, lower_bound_gain = Qhat(keep) - Qhat(p) - z U_diff. Switch iff the best feasible challenger has lower_bound_gain > hysteresis_s and > 0 (min_residency never binds on a fresh controller). A scheduled instance also records single_shape: the decision on the same candidates with the lists dropped.
